  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Identify and discuss the operational tenets found in secure deployments.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      List out the Poor Security Practices which may result in security attack.                   (2)  
  C)      Illustrate with the example the components, working and need of Public Key  
  Infrastructure.                                                                             (5)  
  
  2)           Demonstrate the working of different trust models of PKI architecture with suitable  
  examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Demonstrate and justify the working of Single Sign on Technique.                            (5)

  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      List out the security attributes with proper explanation                                    (2)  
  C)      Assume you are sending a ping request to another system in the network. In this  
  scenario, construct and explain the flow diagram of the packets with respect to the         (5)  
  different chains of iptables tool.  
  
  4)           Illustrate with examples that the people or the employees of an organization work as a  
  security tool.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Demonstrate the working of Challenge Handshake Authentication Protocol (CHAP  
  protocol).                                                                                  (4)  
  
  C)      Identify the limitations of Network based Intrusion detection system.                       (2)  
  5)           Pranav Technologies has planned to start a new service for its clients. The clients can get (5)
